breakdown.description: For curved flow, pressure is higher on the outside of the turn to provide the required centripetal force; stating pressure increases toward the center reverses the correct direction of the pressure gradient.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Pressure increases toward center of curvature,' which directly repeats the original error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth indicates pressure increases outward (away from the center of curvature), with dP/dn = ρV²/R where n is directed outward. The agent failed to correct this reversed pressure gradient direction.
